# Canonical Acadia icon assets

`house-solid.svg` is the unmodified Font Awesome Free 7.3.0 Classic Solid house
from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@7.3.0/svgs/solid/house.svg.
Copyright 2026 Fonticons, Inc.; icons licensed CC BY 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ and https://fontawesome.com/license/free.
The original SVG attribution is retained. This is the canonical Home silhouette
for Acadia and product adapters, including native iOS. It replaces SF Symbols
house variants for Home; no other product icons are changed by this asset.
